title: Kelly Appoints Patrick McCall as Chief Growth Officer
author: Na
description: Kelly Services has appointed Patrick McCall as chief growth officer effective February 16, 2026. McCall, a seasoned workforce solutions executive with 30 years of experience, joins from AMN Healthcare and will report to CEO Chris Layden. He will be responsible for accelerating organic growth, strengthening strategic accounts, and building an integrated go-to-market model.

The emphasis on accelerating organic growth and market share gains indicates positive business outlook and operational improvements.

title: Should Invesco S&P SmallCap Value with Momentum ETF (XSVM) Be on Your Investing Radar?
author: Zacks.Com
description: The Invesco S&P SmallCap Value with Momentum ETF (XSVM) is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the small-cap value segment of the US equity market. The ETF has gained around 9.85% so far this year and 18.48% in the last one year. Investors may consider XSVM as an option for exposure to the small-cap value market.
